title: 第3章 五星伥鬼六星吊死鬼第4章 白鹿商会赵巧儿
slug: 无敌的女厉鬼有点恋爱脑
lines: 眼看又是一场唇枪舌战即将爆发，抬辇上的那位极品美妇只是轻轻摆了摆手，所有的喧嚣便都沉寂了下去。
最终，在留下三件厚实的羊皮袄后，这支队伍才浩浩荡荡地离去。
临走前，那美妇斜倚在软轿上，回眸一瞥，目光落在陆远身上，嘴角噙着一抹若有似无的笑意。
“有空了就回奉天城，你琴姨可总念叨你呢。”
她的声音软糯，像带着钩子，在微冷的空气里漾开。
陆远心头微动，有些不自然地点了点头。
“好嘞，好嘞……”
直到那一行人的身影彻底消失在山路的尽头。
许二小和王成安已经迫不及待地将那触感温软的羊皮袄裹在了身上。
“嘿，真他娘的暖和！”
许二小穿上后，咧着大嘴，脸上笑开了花。
旁边的王成安却是一脸的好奇，凑过来低声问：
“陆哥儿，琴姨是谁啊？”
陆远也正将羊皮袄往身上套，闻言还没来得及解释，许二小便抢着摇头晃脑地开了口：
“也是一匹大……”
话音未落，砰的一声闷响。
许二小的屁股结结实实地挨了陆远一脚。
他捂着腚，龇牙咧嘴地改口道：
“也是一位极漂亮的夫人！跟刚才那位大胭脂马一个级别的哩！”
“老鼻子有钱了，咱真龙观那几座新修的偏殿，就是琴姨一个人捐的。”
王成安进道观晚，对这些旧事一无所知，听得目瞪口呆。
“我的天，还有跟那位大胭脂马一样好看的？”
许二小连连点头，说得唾沫横飞：
“那当然！不过琴姨没她那么高，也就一米七出头，身段没法比。”
刚换好袄子的陆远，瞥了一眼旁边身高刚过一米六的许二小，只觉得好笑。
“你一个一米六的矮冬瓜，还好意思说琴姨‘才’一米七？”
陆远一边重新系紧腰间的绑绳，一边忍不住吐槽。
琴姨那一米七的身高，别说是在这个普遍食不果腹的世道。
就是放在他前世的地球，也妥妥是高挑出众的女神级别。
而放在这群营养不良、普遍长不高的“哥布林”衬托下，那更是鹤立鸡群，风姿绰约。
“那琴姨跟陆哥儿关系可好了呗？”
王成安一脸好奇的八卦着。
许二小与有荣焉地挺起胸膛：
“那当然了，咱道观里的新殿，那琴姨就完全是冲着咱陆哥儿面子才捐的。”
说到这里，许二小则是望着一旁的陆远无比好奇道：
“陆哥儿，你跟那琴姨到底咋回事哩，咋关系那么好嘞。
content_en:
Seeing that another verbal battle was about to break out, the extremely beautiful woman on the carriage just waved her hand gently, and all the noise fell silent.
Finally, after leaving behind three thick sheepskin coats, the team left in a mighty manner.
Before leaving, the beautiful woman leaned on the soft sedan and glanced back. Her eyes fell on Lu Yuan, with a faint smile on her lips.
"Go back to Fengtian City when you have time. Your Aunt Qin is always talking about you."
Her voice was soft and soft, like a hook, rippled in the slightly cold air.
Lu Yuan's heart moved slightly and he nodded unnaturally.
"Okay, okay..."
Until the figure of the group of people completely disappeared at the end of the mountain road.
Xu Erxiao and Wang Chengan could not wait to wrap themselves up in the soft-touch sheepskin jackets.
"Hey, it's so damn warm!"
After Xu Erxiao put it on, he grinned widely and his face blossomed into a smile.
Wang Chengan next to him had a curious look on his face. He came over and asked in a low voice:
"Brother Lu, who is Aunt Qin?"
Lu Yuan was also putting his sheepskin coat on his body. Before he could explain, Xu Erxiao shook his head and spoke:
"It's also a big one..."
Before he finished speaking, there was a muffled sound.
Xu Erxiao received a firm kick from Lu Yuan on the butt.
He covered his buttocks, bared his teeth and changed his words:
"She is also a very beautiful lady! She is on the same level as the big rouge horse just now!"
"Old Nose is rich. The newly built side halls in our True Dragon Temple were donated by Aunt Qin alone."
Wang Chengan entered the Taoist temple late and knew nothing about these old events, so he was stunned when he heard them.
"Oh my god, is there anyone as beautiful as that big rouge horse?"
Xu Erxiao nodded repeatedly and spitted:
"Of course! But Aunt Qin is not as tall as her, only a little over 1.7 meters tall, so her figure is incomparable."
Lu Yuan, who had just changed into his coat, glanced at Xu Erxiao, who was just over 1.6 meters tall next to him, and felt funny.
"You are a short winter melon that is only 1.6 meters tall. How dare you say that Aunt Qin is only 1.7 meters tall?"
Lu Yuan couldn't help but complain as he re-tightened the rope around his waist.
Aunt Qin is 1.7 meters tall, let alone in this world where food is generally not enough.
Even on the earth in his previous life, he was at the level of a tall and outstanding goddess.
And against the backdrop of this group of "goblins" who were malnourished and generally short of height, he stood out from the crowd and was graceful.
"Then the relationship between Aunt Qin and Brother Lu is good?"
Wang Chengan gossiped with curiosity on his face.
Xu Erxiao proudly puffed up his chest:
"Of course, Aunt Qin donated the new temple in our Taoist temple purely for Brother Lu's sake."
Speaking of this, Xu Erxiao looked at Lu Yuan on the side and said curiously:
"Brother Lu, what's going on between you and Aunt Qin? Why do you have such a good relationship?
